**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 4 of the RadialSpark agreement already sits at the playbook's preferred position on the material terms:

- **Deliverables vest in us** — all SOW work product ("Works") is "the property of Company" for work we have been invoiced and have paid, with Contractor bound to execute further documents to perfect our rights (p0017–p0018).
- **Vendor keeps only pre-existing IP** — its own software, methodologies and know-how not created for us (p0020), which the playbook expressly permits.
- **Licence-back exists** — a perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and create derivatives of any Contractor Information embedded in the Works for our business operations (p0021), reinforced by the post-payment right to modify the software or hire others to do so at no further cost (p0022).
- **No walk-away triggers** — no assignment or licence of Clear Capital IP or data to Contractor, no joint ownership; § 5(b) carves Company-provided programs, data and materials out of Contractor's granting rights.

Noted in the rationale rather than redlined (minor sub-elements): no standalone Customer Data ownership sentence (our data is covered as Confidential Information in § 8), ownership drafted as vesting rather than a present assignment, further-assurance assistance at our cost, and the licence-back not labelled "irrevocable"/"worldwide."
